1479-2841-4677-8098.description:
Fetch a land using Mountain Valley.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.

628-997-7865.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

1636-1719-2681-7870.description:
Activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Forbidden Orchard triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token under an opponent's control.
When the Spirit enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
Activate Hawkeye by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Spirit token. This'll destroy it due to it having 0 toughness.
Hawkeye triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2557-5702-7798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
2557-5702-7798.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

3010-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3010-3259-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Moonblade Shinobi, triggering Breath of Fury and Moonblade Shinobi.
Resolve the Moonblade Shinobi trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1409-3099-5295-6006.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

4559-4802-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4802-6797-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5147-6026-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5147-6026-7084.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Field of Souls and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2511-4605-4681-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {5}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Karmic Guide and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

877-4264-6967.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying {2}{G}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Honest Rutstein.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Altered Ego triggers, returning Honest Rutstein from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Honest Rutstein by paying {0} due to Morophon and Altered Ego.
Put Honest Rutstein into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Honest Rutstein triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 4.

4681-5170-6273-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

539-5412-7008.description:
Cast Badgermole Cub by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Badgermole Cub
When Badgermole Cub dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole Cub enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-4740-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2292-4740-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Repeat.

3664-4826-5701-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are two mana-producing land cards in your graveyard.
There are three or more card types among cards in your graveyard excluding the "Creature" type.
3664-4826-5701-5720-5721.description:
Play Lotus Field. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Lotus Field trigger, sacrificing it and Echoing Deeps.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
When Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field enter, they each trigger.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps, Lotus Field and two other mana-producing lands except Shifting Woodland by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the Echoing Deeps and Lotus Field triggers, sacrificing them and the lands tapped for mana in step 6.
Activate Shifting Woodland's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos. Choose to have Echoing Deeps enter as a copy of Lotus Field.
Repeat from step 5.

341-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
341-5078-6650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

413-1329-2178-3661.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
413-1329-2178-3661.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
When Shield Sphere enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

222-527-1322-5686.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1322-5686.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

372-1922-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1922-4477.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3128-4499-4893.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Skullport Merchant.
When Skullport Merchant enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

813-2104-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and Scholar of the Ages each turn.
813-2104-6122.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Scholar of the Ages by paying its mana cost.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Scholar of the Ages from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1987-2104-4423-4477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2104-4423-4477.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

413-2777-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Driver of the Dead in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
413-2777-5326.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Driver of the Dead.
When The Master enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

38-1661-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skirk Prospector on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying {R}.
Repeat.

224-578-596-2043.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three artifact cards in hand.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
224-578-596-2043.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least three artifact cards from your hand, adding at least six {C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Darksteel Citadel that is a 1/1 Soldier.
When the Darksteel Citadel token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.
If you have four or more artifact cards in hand, this combo nets infinite colorless mana, and you may target any artifact you control to get infinite copies of them.

392-3247-3327-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
392-3247-3327-4740.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi and Aetherflux Reservoir trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Razaketh by paying two life and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Razaketh ability, causing you to search your library for a card and put it into your hand.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to any target.
Repeat step 9 as many times as desired.

3525-3772.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Omen Hawker.
Omen Hawker does not have summoning sickness.
3525-3772.description:
Activate Omen Hawker by tapping it, adding {C}{U} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Omen Hawker.
Repeat.

546-1034-1350.notablePrerequisites: Ramos has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
546-1034-1350.description:
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ramos to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Ramos by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Lux Artillery triggers, causing Ramos to gain sunburst and enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

246-3705-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Poxwalkers and Squee, adding {R}{R}.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Poxwalkers triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1634-1860-2567-3858.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four lands.
1634-1860-2567-3858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, allowing you to cast all spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Devilish Valet.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
Each Plant token enters the battlefield, triggering Devilish Valet that many times.
Resolve a Devilish Valet trigger, doubling its power until end of turn.
Repeat step 7 for each remaining Devilish Valet trigger.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.
